quote: The contract, which is worth €100 million, split equally between ETF and Colas Rail, involves three years of works, including in particular dismantling the existing track, providing the materials (track, sleepers, ballast and overhead lines, etc.), as well as the construction and commissioning of a new suburban railway line.
note: Opened Colas English; EUR 100m / 21.5 km S2 / 50-50 ETF–Colas confirmed. CapEx USD via Fed H.10 Sep 25 2026 1.1400.
